title: Want to Improve Your English?
excerpt: If you want to improve your English, the best move is to get help from an expert. I'm not the right person for that, but I can help with AI.

blocks.text: Maybe by reading these texts I've posted about English, you'll also make the decision to go and find your own path for the language. But I really recommend you get help from an expert for this. That's the best way!
Always learn to ask experts in a field for help finding your own path, even if it costs money.

Because an expert in that field has a very good view of the different challenges and the future of that field. They also have experiences that they share with you, and being aware of those gives you a much more open and better perspective.

So, I really don't have knowledge about the complexities of English. If you really want your English to get better, the best thing is to go to someone who is an expert in this field and ask them for help :)
If you need help in AI and AI Engineering, then I'm one of the best people who can help you. But for learning English, language tests, and so on, I'm the worst person who can help you.
Let's be honest with each other - right?
